text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear that Mejiro Ardan has something to discuss with me, but when she comes to my office…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As you are aware, Trainer, the situation with my leg keeps me from adopting the trial-and-error approach utilized by others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As such, I wish for you to select only the most opportune times for me to run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Of course, when you deem it necessary for me to enter a race, I will run with all I have. Please choose wisely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan won't show it, but I can tell she's exhausted. Revising her race schedule might be a good idea.
